style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular robotic assembly resting on a weathered concrete garage floor. Three recognizable engineered parts arranged in an asymmetrical deconstructed layout: a heavy central robotic base module, an unlatched snow auger bay, and an adjacent lawn mower deck. Hard clean edges, brushed steel and deep pine green matte polymer surfaces. One directional key light from the left throwing long cast shadows, generous negative space, matte muted palette, no text, no molded lettering.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, typography, watermarks, UI, numbers
rationale: The narrative hinges entirely on the modularity of the robotic platform and the financial necessity of swapping attachments on a single base core. A component assembly perfectly deconstructs this physical and economic relationship.
cue: modular platform, not a snow blower
subject: a modular robotic base unit unlatched from a snow auger module and a mower deck
core_thesis: Yarbo prices the Y40 snow setup as a modular platform, where the base unit requires the summer mower module to justify the high entry cost.
core_conflict: High entry capital cost versus multi-season modular utility.
